GOALS_EXPLAIN.title: How your time is shared
GOALS_EXPLAIN.text: Each goal gets a share of activity time in proportion to its priority. First every goal reaches its weekly minimum, then deadline quests, then weekly targets, and extra volume only if your intensity setting allows it. No single goal may take more than 60% of the time while another is below its minimum.

GOALS_EMPTY.title: No goals yet
GOALS_EMPTY.text: Goals turn into regular sessions on your calendar. Quests that ask for the same kind of activity share those sessions instead of doubling up.

tables.GOAL_REMOVE_CONFIRM: Remove this goal? Its future sessions are removed; completed ones stay in your history.
tables.CLARIFY_TEXT: Life Director needs to know what this goal looks like in practice. Pick the closest match:

QUEST_HEAD.title: Connected to your Quest Board
QUEST_HEAD.text: Life Director reads your quests, schedules time for the ones that need it, and checks them off on the Quest Board when the sessions are done. Quest XP is paid by LifeMax once per period, so nothing is counted twice.

tables.MILESTONE_NOTE: These are earned through everything else you do, so Life Director doesn’t plan time for them.

INTENSITY.note: Light schedules only each goal’s weekly minimum. Ambitious and All in add extra sessions when time allows.

PREF_RANGES: A hard daily ceiling, even on free days.
Kept clear before anything else is planned.
After this, Life Director inserts something lighter.
GRACE: Grace period before a session counts as missed

MISSES.text: Gentle: no consequences, missed sessions are just re-planned. Standard: a rest token covers a miss; without one, that activity’s streak drops by one. Hardcore: also reports an HP penalty (never below 1 HP). At most one consequence per day, and never any XP or level loss.

SETTINGS_TEXT.restNote: Hard workouts and heavy study are avoided on these days when possible.

guide.title: Guide
guide.text: A short walkthrough of how to read each screen. It shows once on its own; you can replay it here or with the ? button at the top.

data.title: Your data
data.text: Saved on this device under its own key, separate from your LifeMax save.
data.resetConfirm: Reset Life Director? Your schedule, goals and settings here are cleared. LifeMax XP and quests are not affected.
data.restoreText: Paste a Life Director backup. This replaces Life Director data only; your LifeMax save is not touched.

DISRUPT.title: Something came up
DISRUPT.note: Nothing here counts against you. Life Director only moves what it has to.

questsModel.missing: Open Life Director inside LifeMax to connect quests. Missing:

timeModel.ledeFirst: Tell Life Director what your time is already spoken for. It plans everything else.
timeModel.lede: Change anything here and your plan rebuilds around it automatically.
timeModel.sleepNote: Drag the two handles, or type the times. Nothing is ever planned into sleep.
timeModel.weekendToggle: Different on Friday and Saturday nights
timeModel.commitEmpty: Nothing yet. Add your job, classes, or anything else that happens at the same time each week.
timeModel.routinesText: Time Life Director keeps around your day so it never books you the minute you wake up.
timeModel.routinesNote: Travel and unwind time after work are set on each commitment.
timeModel.goalsEmpty: Add at least one goal so there is something to plan. Your LifeMax quests are included automatically.

ruleForm.name: Name
ruleForm.note: Overnight shifts are fine: an end time earlier than the start runs into the next morning. Tiring shifts keep heavy sessions away from the hours after them.

goalTypeModel.title: Add a goal
goalTypeModel.text: Pick the closest kind of goal. Life Director turns it into regular, sensibly spaced sessions.

goalFormModel.name: Name
goalFormModel.foldNote: Life Director paces sessions to hit the date, and tells you honestly if the date is not realistic.

activityAtForm.title: Add an activity
activityAtForm.text: Schedule one activity at the time you held.
activityAtForm.name: Activity name
activityAtForm.note: Adds a pinned activity to an already planned day. It does not log completion or award XP. Sleep, work and existing activities stay protected.

disruptParts.workTitle: Called into work or an extra commitment
disruptParts.sickNote: Demanding sessions are cleared and only must-do work is moved to after you recover.
disruptParts.energyNote: Adjusts estimates for the next several hours, then fades out.

moveModel.none: No open time fits this week.
moveModel.noteTail: . The moved session is pinned so automatic re-planning leaves it alone.
